sourceFindings: Kruskal/KD-tree/DSU selection is byte-unchanged. Only emitted selected-edge order and queue are changed.

Feature-on stable partition preserves selected noncoincident-XY edges in exact relative order; only new coincident-XY selected layer edges move after them before sequential _mstN naming. Explicit initially-connected edges still filter before naming/emission.
Both base and active OffBoard override use the same helper methods. Original two-point connection fast paths still push in their existing position and never enter deferred queue.
Feature-off creates no deferred own property and uses original edge array. New helper methods are on the prototype only.
All deferred connections flush before cold completed=true and solved=true. Queue is emptied, so repeated completion cannot duplicate added demands; partial stages never claim completed coverage.
OffBoard selection still receives the original selected edge and native equivalence lookup; defer classification uses original selected coincidence, with optimized points preserved unmodified.
Coverage calculation remains before ordering/defer, with exact original nine fields. No added budget, validator change, routing acceptance waiver or native via/terminal adapter edit.

scenarios: every original demand remains native prefix in tiny fixtures
original coincident two-point demand position unchanged
explicit external preconnection filters one new bridge
preloaded trace+external groups filter both bridges
active nontrivial offboard group preserves native substitution
queue drains once and cannot duplicate on repeated completion

limitations: No real dataset routing, benchmark, or checker execution by this review.
Actual18:11 regression cause is not proved by this ordering change; original-serverZIP geometry and a fresh qualified targeted trial must establish whether it helps.

Preserving emitted selected-edge order/names does not assert all arbitrary-input legacy positive MST selections are identical: unchanged KNN expansion may select differently when layer-aware connectivity needs more neighbors.
Restored intermediate or emitted layer requirements remain separate from actual manufactured via contacts and full electrical/board PASS.
